item.title: Amateur may have cracked Linear A, a 120-year-old puzzle
item.description:
📝 Di Mino is not the first to argue that Linear A was Semitic. Because Linear A and Linear B have 60 symbols in common, and because Linear B has been deciphered, experts could guess what the overlapping Linear A symbols sounded like but didn’t know what the sounds meant. And there were 13 additional symbols in Linear A that did not appear in Linear B.
🔗 Read more: https://aiclambake.com/clamtakes/linear-a/

item.title: A new bill takes aim at government pressure to silence lawful online speech
item.description:
📝 The government’s coercion violated Aaron’s First Amendment rights. We’ve also filed a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit against the same government agencies that threatened Aaron and other services that provided forums to report ICE activity. When federal officials pressure private companies into censoring protected speech, it can violate the First Amendment.
🔗 Read more: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/new-bill-takes-aim-government-pressure-silence-lawful-online-speech
